postNewGameActionList: Redemption table created. Load a deck, shuffle, draw 8. Lost Souls drawn from deck go to Land of Bondage and are replaced. No other rules are enforced.

drawnLostSoulToBondage._comment: When a Lost Soul is drawn from deck to hand, put it in Land of Bondage and draw a replacement.

autoRun.promptMessage: Put this Lost Soul into the Land of Bondage and draw a replacement?

then: {{$TARGET.sides.A.name}} is a Lost Soul and is placed in the Land of Bondage.
